title: SvgFeColorMatrix
responsibility: Renders the native feColorMatrix element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: SvgFeColorMatrix.children
inputs.description: Optional Svelte Snippet rendered inside the native feColorMatrix element when supplied; when omitted, the component renders no child content. The component does not otherwise transform or interpret the snippet.

outputs.name: SvgFeColorMatrix
outputs.description: Native feColorMatrix markup created by the dynamic element; remaining attributes are spread onto it, and supplied children are rendered inside it. The component adds no wrapper or other behavior.
